name: Mahamaya Therapeutics Learning & Prescription Intelligence Engine (MTLPI)
mode: Educational clinician decision support; no autonomous prescribing.
design_principles: Complaint alone does not generate a drug-of-choice prescription.
Specific therapy candidates appear after clinician diagnosis/context selection or explicit learning search.
Generic-first; brands are search aliases/examples only and never ranked by quality.
Candidate cards show indications, key contraindications/interactions, renal/hepatic/pregnancy cautions, ADRs, monitoring and provenance.
Load-to-draft only fills existing prescription fields; clinician must review, add medicine and run safety screening.
Pediatric, pregnancy, severe renal/hepatic disease and emergency contexts trigger conservative gating.
Antibiotics require diagnosis/indication + stewardship review; symptom-only antibiotic suggestions are blocked.

priority_legend.green: Usual first-line/preferred candidate in the specified diagnosed context if eligible.
